stopping: Submit the current answer; no additional solver call. A controller request that chose stop still counts.
repair_or_retry: Pay the executed solver input/output tokens and replace the current answer; after two extra calls submit the latest answer.
counted_tokens: Initial solver call, every executed additional solver call, and every executed LLM-controller call, including its input, output and any reasoning tokens already included in provider completion totals.
excluded_from_episode_tokens: Unvisited solver branches, offline dataset collection, other questions, and other experimental runs. Those still contribute to collection billing, reported separately.
lambda_selection: Set from a declared cost preference or report a fixed tradeoff grid; do not maximize raw utility across different lambdas or select from test outcomes.
llm_sweep: Generate controller decisions separately at each lambda because the objective is included in its prompt. Do not pretend fixed-prompt reweighting is a retuned controller.
future_pomdp: Later fit correctness transitions, confidence observations and expected action token costs from training only. No POMDP fitting or evaluation is part of this workflow.
limitations: Token counts are a compute proxy, not FLOPs or USD, especially across differently sized models. Provider billing and controller latency are separate measurements. Test outcomes from the current dataset have already been inspected.
